kql:

| where (ActingProcessName == "cmd.exe" or ActingProcessName == "ftp.exe" or ActingProcessName == "schtasks.exe" or ActingProcessName == "powershell.exe" or ActingProcessName == "rundll32.exe" or ActingProcessName == "regsvr32.exe" or ActingProcessName == "msiexec.exe")

kql:
imProcessCreate
| where ActingProcessName == "rundll32.exe"

imProcessCreate
| where ActingProcessName == "rundll32.exe"

imDns
| where DstGeoCountry !in ("US", "CA", "GB", "AU", "NZ", "DE", "FR", "JP")
| summarize DnsQueryCount = count(), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated), Domains = make_set(DstDomain, 100)    by SrcIpAddr, DstDomain, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where DnsQueryCount > 10

imDns
| summarize QueryCount = count(), Queries = make_list(DnsQuery, 100), FirstQueryTime = min(TimeGenerated), LastQueryTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where QueryCount > 10
| project SrcIpAddr, Queries, FirstQueryTime, LastQueryTime, QueryCount

imDns
| where TimeGenerated >= "P2D"
| where TimeGenerated < "P1D"
| summarize TotalCount = count(), Durations = make_set(DnsNetworkDuration, 100), MaxDuration = max(DnsNetworkDuration), MinDuration = min(DnsNetworkDuration)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where TotalCount >= 15
| project SrcIpAddr, TotalCount, Durations

imDns
| where DnsResponseCodeName != "NOERROR"
| summarize ErrorCount = count(), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| project SrcIpAddr, ErrorCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime

imDns
| where DnsResponseCodeName != "NOERROR"
| summarize NonNoerrorCount = count(), ResponseCodes = make_set(DnsResponseCodeName, 25), EventStartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EventEndTime = max(TimeGenerated)    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| project SrcIpAddr, NonNoerrorCount, ResponseCodes, EventStartTime, EventEndTime

| where ServerErrorCount > 1

| where HttpStatusCode < 600

imWebSession

| where HttpStatusCode < 600
| summarize ServerErrorCount = count()    by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where ServerErrorCount > 100

imWebSession

imWebSession

imWebSession

imWebSession

imWebSession

imWebSession
